nodes.community_name: Usage Tracking and n8n Token Plan
nodes.norm_label: own token per client (new signature by crt_ prefix)
nodes.rationale: firmar decides by the token prefix, so a row can keep the global secret and later switch to its own token by changing only the row value; no node carries a hardcoded secret.

nodes.rationale: One flow serves every client; what changes per client lives in a table row, so onboarding a client never duplicates or edits a flow.

nodes.label: Plan global constraints
nodes.community_name: Usage Tracking and n8n Token Plan
nodes.rationale: Only the inactive copy flow is modified and only a token column is added, because the other flows are live; the secret must never be written in a node, the repo or command output; Code nodes cannot require crypto so the HMAC is pure JS; no push or deploy.

nodes.label: Plan review focus (failure cases)
nodes.community_name: Usage Tracking and n8n Token Plan
nodes.rationale: Never sign with an empty token; a failed usage report must not block the poster; each generation gets a distinct eventId; no empty tokens object; pure-JS HMAC must match node:crypto for unicode and multi-MB bodies.

nodes.label: Per-client webhook token (crt_, AES-256-GCM, timestamped HMAC)
nodes.norm_label: per-client webhook token (crt_, aes-256-gcm, timestamped hmac)
nodes.rationale: Each carousel signs with its own token so one client secret cannot be used for another; 5 min window and no replays; legacy global signature kept for users without a token during transition.

nodes.label: Sessions: JWT with sid and sv (revocation)
nodes.norm_label: sessions: jwt with sid and sv (revocation)
nodes.rationale: Logout revokes the sid and a password change bumps the version; handlers must use requireSession rather than verifyToken so revocation is honoured.

nodes.label: Storage quota and per-user file ledger
nodes.norm_label: storage quota and per-user file ledger
nodes.rationale: All writes go through saveUserFile and deletes through removeUserFile so the quota (413 QUOTA_EXCEEDED) and file ownership are always enforced.

nodes.label: Monthly usage counters and estimated cost
nodes.norm_label: monthly usage counters and estimated cost

nodes.label: CORS policy
nodes.rationale: Access-Control-Allow-Origin is *, because sensitive access is protected by cookie/JWT and HMAC rather than by CORS.

nodes.label: n8n request signing (token + timestamp vs legacy global secret)
nodes.norm_label: n8n request signing (token + timestamp vs legacy global secret)

nodes.label: POST /api/images-upload (manual upload from panel)
nodes.rationale: The body is streamed to a temp file and converted to WebP from disk one at a time, because each sharp optimization costs about 80 MB of native RAM.

nodes.label: POST /api/video-upload (H.264 MP4/MOV only)
nodes.rationale: The server never transcodes; conversion happens in the browser with Mediabunny so the small server only streams the file to disk.

nodes.label: Create Upstash Redis via Vercel Marketplace
nodes.norm_label: create upstash redis via vercel marketplace
nodes.rationale: Vercel KV is obsolete, so the project uses Upstash Redis; the client accepts both KV_REST_API_* and UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_* names.

nodes.label: Vercel Blob store (must be public)
nodes.rationale: A private store makes /api/upload fail and the carousel cannot show the images, so the Blob store must be public.

nodes.label: Large images: file as request body (no base64)
nodes.norm_label: large images: file as request body (no base64)
nodes.rationale: Base64 forces the server to load the whole body in memory (8 MB cap); a raw body is streamed to disk and the signature is computed over the bytes.

nodes.label: HMAC-SHA256 signature over the exact raw body
nodes.norm_label: hmac-sha256 signature over the exact raw body
nodes.rationale: The server signs the raw text it receives, so the body must be serialized once and reused byte for byte for both signing and sending.

nodes.label: Carrusel V2 - Agente workflow (Telegram AI agent with approval)

nodes.label: Storage full handling (413 QUOTA_EXCEEDED in the bot)
nodes.norm_label: storage full handling (413 quota_exceeded in the bot)

nodes.label: Permanent re-hosting flow (upload then webhook append)
nodes.norm_label: permanent re-hosting flow (upload then webhook append)
nodes.rationale: Image generators return temporary URLs (Alibaba/Qwen expires in about 24 h), so images are re-hosted before being added to the carousel.

nodes.label: Usage reporting from n8n (Firmar consumo -> Reportar consumo)
nodes.norm_label: usage reporting from n8n (firmar consumo -> reportar consumo)
nodes.rationale: The report never stops the flow and sits above Fijar foto on the canvas so it runs before waiting for client approval; eventId makes retries idempotent.

nodes.label: Base poster rules (catalog photo, correct Spanish, never invent price, max quality)
nodes.norm_label: base poster rules (catalog photo, correct spanish, never invent price, max quality)

nodes.label: Security overview (Argon2id, JWT cookie, HMAC, rate limiting)
nodes.norm_label: security overview (argon2id, jwt cookie, hmac, rate limiting)

nodes.label: Poster technical specs V2 (docs/POSTER-SPECS.md)
nodes.rationale: Mirror of the generation rules; the source of truth is the system prompt of the Carrusel V2 - Agente workflow and this file is a backup kept in sync.

nodes.label: Known gotchas (no @vercel/kv, @node-rs/argon2 instead of argon2)
nodes.rationale: Vercel KV is sunset so the Redis client targets Upstash REST; native argon2 is avoided because @node-rs/argon2 ships prebuilt binaries that build reliably on Vercel.

nodes.label: No module-scope setInterval/setTimeout in api/
nodes.rationale: A background loop keeps serverless instances alive; rate-limit cleanup is done opportunistically instead.

nodes.label: No build step, no framework, ESM everywhere
nodes.norm_label: no build step, no framework, esm everywhere
nodes.rationale: Frontend is plain HTML/CSS/JS and backend is Vercel Functions; keep it dependency-free and do not introduce React/Vite for small changes.

nodes.label: Security invariants (do not break)
nodes.rationale: HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite=Strict cookie, Argon2id password check, HMAC of the raw body with timingSafeEqual, admin JWT for mutations, token returned once and stored encrypted, userId normalized before storage keys, file deletable only by its owner.

nodes.label: EC2 shared-host memory limits and oom_score_adj
nodes.norm_label: ec2 shared-host memory limits and oom_score_adj
nodes.rationale: The EC2 is shared with plasticosvirgo.com: memory limits plus a high oom_score_adj make the kernel kill these containers before the Next.js site; the image is built locally and loaded with docker load so nothing compiles on the server; nginx on the host proxies HTTPS.

nodes.label: UPLOAD_ALLOWED_HOSTS SSRF guard
nodes.rationale: The upload endpoint downloads a remote URL, so its host must be in an allowlist to avoid SSRF; sending the image as base64 or raw body avoids SSRF and temporary URLs altogether.
